hero.title: Every community deserves a fair start, and we show up until it gets one.
hero.subtitle: Janak Adhikari leads Sangharsh Samajik Sanstha, a people-first movement bringing schooling, healthcare and steady livelihoods to families that have waited too long.

intro.title: A leader who listens first, and a movement that acts next
paragraphs: Sangharsh means struggle. For Janak Adhikari it has never been a slogan, it is the daily work of sitting with families, hearing what they need and not leaving until something changes.
Today the Sanstha runs programmes across education, health, women's empowerment and livelihoods, always led by the people they serve.

highlights.title: Community-led
highlights.text: Local volunteers shape every programme, from planning to follow-up.

highlights.title: Open about money
highlights.text: Accounts and outcomes are shared with supporters every year.

highlights.title: Built to last
highlights.text: We train local people so the work continues after our teams leave.

highlights.title: Dignity first
highlights.text: Help is offered as a right, never as charity.
